# PhishDefend AI (Phish Defend)

> PhishDefend AI is an AI-powered, fully automated phishing simulation and anti-phishing training platform for European SMEs (KMU). Also known as "Phish Defend".

- [Homepage](https://phishdefend-ai.vercel.app/): Features, pricing, FAQ (German)
- [llms-full.txt](https://phishdefend-ai.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Full entity details for AI assistants
- [Privacy Policy](https://phishdefend-ai.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Data Processing Agreement](https://phishdefend-ai.vercel.app/data-processing-agreement): DPA / AVV per GDPR Art. 28
- [Impressum](https://phishdefend-ai.vercel.app/impressum)

## Entity

- **Name:** PhishDefend AI
- **Also known as:** Phish Defend, PhishDefend, Phish Defend AI
- **Type:** B2B SaaS, security awareness platform
- **Category:** Phishing simulation, social engineering testing, security awareness training
- **What it does:** Runs automated, AI-personalized phishing tests and anti-phishing training with a 2-minute micro-training after every click (no sanctions — positive security culture). Covers phishing, spear-phishing, CEO fraud (BEC), vishing, smishing. No dashboard — results arrive via email and Slack.
- **Who it is for:** European SMEs (KMU), primarily Germany, approx. 10–500 employees, without a dedicated security team.
- **What it offers:** 25 automated campaigns/year, AI-personalized templates, vishing & smishing modules, real-time alerts, micro-training, monthly PDF reports, risk scoring, NIS2/ISO 27001 audit evidence.
- **Compared to:** KnowBe4, SoSafe, Hoxhunt or gophish — PhishDefend AI is fully automated, dashboard-less, hosted in Germany.
- **Pricing:** €1,000/year (Starter, up to 50 employees), €2,500/year (Business, up to 200, incl. Vishing), Custom (Enterprise). Vishing/Smishing add-ons from €200/month.
- **Compliance:** GDPR (Art. 6(1)(f)) + DPA (Art. 28), hosted in Germany (Hetzner, Frankfurt), AES-256 & TLS 1.3, auto-deletion (raw data 90 days / logs 7 days), NIS2-compliant, ISO 27001-ready (A.6.3 & A.5.36).
- **Key results:** Click rate from ~30% to <5% within 6 months; 99.7% email deliverability.
